### `OutputEncoder`

The encoder that writes a video (spec 13 §13.5.5): the CPU encoders of §13.5.1 or NVENC on a
box with a GPU.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"cpu"` | x264, x265, SVT-AV1, libvpx, ProRes (the default). |
| `"nvenc"` | NVIDIA NVENC (h264, hevc, av1; no alpha plane, no ProRes or VP9, no PQ); only on a GPU box. |
